newsitem.title: BRAZIL: ADVISORY - Brazil bolsas switch to summer hours Mon.
newsitem.headline: ADVISORY - Brazil bolsas switch to summer hours Mon.

text.p: Brazilian stock and futures markets will move trading hours up starting Monday as the country moves clocks ahead for southern hemisphere summer hours, market officials said.
Clocks will advance an hour at midnight Saturday and, on Monday, stock and futures markets in Sao Paulo and Rio de Janeiro will begin trading at 1030 local/0830 EDT/1230 gmt, officials said.
The markets will close at 1730 local/1530 EDT/1930 gmt.
Under the Brazilian daylight savings time, the country's populous eastern region, including Sao Paulo and Rio, will be two hours ahead of New York and two hours behind GMT.
